# MDB synchronous open keeps one local operation reference across progress and conversion

OpenMDB takes a local nsCOMPtr copy of the in-progress m_thumb before entering the synchronous progress loop. Both DoMore and ThumbToOpenStore use that same local operation. Its reference remains owned until the enclosing block exits, even when the member is cleared; ClearCachedObjects has a separate member-reset path. The cached-open caller and header identify non-null m_thumb as an asynchronous open in progress. This is a narrow lifetime/state contract, not proof of the historical crash mechanism, general thread safety or successful native folder loading.

Scope: Message database MDB open-operation ownership.
